arguments.sql: SELECT orders.order_date, orders.status, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total FROM orders INNER JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id INNER JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Fonderie Vasseur SARL') GROUP BY orders.id
